levels.title: First Sweep
levels.challenge: Basic direct drag and same-colour collection.
levels.blockerIntent: Foreign-color Sproutlings stay mostly out of the way; learn the base interaction first.

levels.title: Bent Paths
levels.blockerIntent: A Sproutling of the other color sits on the convenient line, teaching that other colors are solid.

levels.title: Three at Once
levels.challenge: Collect multiple Sproutlings during free 2D dragging.
levels.blockerIntent: Three colors create the first soft obstacle field without making the board cramped.

levels.title: Busy Middle
levels.blockerIntent: Four color fields shape shared maneuvering space around the center.

levels.title: Outside Loop
levels.challenge: Read wider spatial routes and outside loops.
levels.blockerIntent: A central green Sproutling cluster makes the perimeter attractive for the long purple Habitat.

levels.title: Cross Traffic
levels.blockerIntent: Opposing target fields make the shared center a contested route.

levels.title: First Lift
levels.challenge: First Elevator: collect/release to reveal the queued Sproutling; queue state is visible and deterministic.

levels.title: Open Practice
levels.challenge: First optional assistance unlock metadata only. Level remains fully solvable without assistance.

levels.title: Two Arrivals
levels.challenge: Plan releases around two independent Elevator queues.

levels.title: Cross Queue
levels.challenge: Two queues with authored mixed-colour order; keep entries usable.

levels.title: Tight Schedule
levels.challenge: First Hard tier: known rules only, deeper queue/space ordering.

levels.title: Four-Way Supply
levels.challenge: Second optional assistance unlock metadata only. Four Elevator directions; booster-free solvability remains mandatory.

levels.title: Quiet Junction
levels.challenge: Consolidation: no new mechanic, just queue timing and route planning.

levels.title: Event Ready
levels.challenge: Campaign board reserved for future optional event overlay; no BonusPickup is required in M6.

levels.title: Guide Grooves
levels.challenge: Tiny movement-constraint tutorial: horizontal and vertical collectors only; no Elevator complexity.

levels.title: Guided Arrival
levels.challenge: Third optional assistance unlock metadata only; combines known queue and movement-constraint rules.

levels.title: Crossed Deliveries
levels.challenge: Hard combination: constrained routes plus authored multi-colour Elevator timing.

levels.title: Mastery Exchange
levels.challenge: Chapter mastery: no new rule, combines free movement, constrained collectors and two queues.
